g.text: what happens when a hop fails
step of both the good and the bad path
a failed send leaves its data
GAP: slots are shared by all
a report in flight or retried:
no new pass, for all kinds
delivery or on give-up, nowhere else
nothing waits on a peer forever
GAP: a link that rejects while
release waits for the next key
in order, or the link goes down
GAP: the dongle has no state
a link that stops taking data
is torn down, and only that link
the caps fit in the pool (7 + 1)
a NUS timeout may cut a healthy
Ignore if no longer in flight
Ignore if no longer in flight
Only path that provably doesn't have a report in flight can do this.
Otherwise, the BLE queue can get filled and stuck.
